Confirm a Payslip Batch and Create the Accounting Entries

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to review a payslip batch and confirm all of its payslips in one step, which locks the payslips and creates the draft accounting entries for the salaries.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. Batches

Click Batches.

4. Open the batch

Click the batch to open it.

5. Create Draft Entry

Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the batch.

6. Confirm in the window

Click Ok to confirm.

7. Check the status

Check that the batch status is now Done, then click the batch name to finish.
